literal: On xinwei day made Yan King Xiao Xiaomu's son Shun Qianniu Guard general.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Yan King Xiao Xiaomu's son Shun was appointed general of the Qianniu Guard.

literal: On jiaxu day made Prince of Zhongshan Commandery Zhage Baojing Army military commissioner, Prince of Le'an Commandery Suige Guangde Army military commissioner, and Xiao Jieli Zhangde Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Prince of Zhongshan Zhage was appointed military commissioner of the Baojing Army, Prince of Le'an Suige military commissioner of the Guangde Army, and Xiao Jieli military commissioner of the Zhangde Army.

literal: On gengchen day made Liaoxing Army military commissioner Prince Zhou Hu Dugu Linhai Army military commissioner, and Qishui Commandery Prince Di Lie Southern Court great king.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince Zhou Hu Dugu was transferred from the Liaoxing Army to the Linhai Army, and Qishui Commandery Prince Di Lie was appointed Southern Court great king.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, favored and visited Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: Eighth month, on bingchen new moon, made Han Shaofang Privy Council direct scholar, and imperial son-in-law Xiao Pidi chief inspector.
idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the eighth month Han Shaofang was appointed Privy Council direct scholar and imperial son-in-law Xiao Pidi chief inspector.

literal: Ninth month, made imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong Wuding Army military commissioner, and Yelü Zongfu An'guo Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: In the ninth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed military commissioner of the Wuding Army and Yelü Zongfu military commissioner of the An'guo Army.

literal: Winter, tenth month, imperial halt at Liao River.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court encamped at the Liao River.

literal: Song dispatched Cai Qi and Li Yonghe to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: Song sent Cai Qi and Li Yonghe to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: Eleventh month, posthumously enfeoffed Southern Court great king Han Zhixin as King of Chen.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Southern Court great king Han Zhixin was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chen.

literal: Twelfth month, made Xiao Congzheng Guiyi Army military commissioner, Kang Jun Gate Guard, serving as deputy envoy to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Congzheng was appointed military commissioner of the Guiyi Army and Kang Jun, gate guard, was made deputy envoy to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

literal: That year, jinshi Li Zisi and forty-seven others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year Li Zisi and forty-seven others passed the examinations.
